verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server that lets merchants operate their PayPal business with natural language through their chosen MCP clients. A runtime probe confirms the remote endpoint is live behind OAuth. The exposed tools cover orders, invoices, refunds, disputes and catalog. Separately, agentic commerce services let shoppers buy using everyday language. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface that does not depend on a third-party MCP client, and independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands execute reliably end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: PayPal built an MCP server that lets merchants use natural language with their favorite MCP clients. This helps users complete business tasks more easily.
PayPal's remote MCP server is live
Integrate with PayPal APIs to access orders, invoices, subscriptions, shipment tracking, transaction details, and dispute management through pre-built functions.
Merchants can use PayPal's agentic commerce services to create AI-powered shopping experiences, so customers can shop using everyday language.
